# AppProcessPauseType

What kind of run a paused app run is waiting for (`pauseAssociatedId` names it).

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"None"` | The run is not paused. |
| `"App"` | Waiting for an app run. |
| `"Interaction"` | Waiting for an interaction run. |
| `"CodeGeneration"` | Waiting for a code pipeline run. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`AppProcess`](app-process.md)
- Inside [`AppProcessWithDetails`](app-process-with-details.md)
